title: Requirement for Authenticated Documents or Court Ruling in Disputes
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Requirement for authenticated documents or court ruling
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that changes to the real estate register data require authenticated documents or a court ruling, and that an administrative document alone is insufficient. FAIL if the note does not state that authenticated documents or a court ruling are required for changes to the real estate register data, or if it implies that an administrative document alone is sufficient.

criteria.title: Governor not a party to the dispute
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the Governor of Beheira is not considered a party to the dispute because the governorate has no connection to the land and made no claims or submissions. FAIL if the note does not state that the Governor of Beheira is excluded as a party, or if it fails to give the reason that the governorate has no connection to the land and made no claims or submissions.

criteria.title: Actual parties to the dispute
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note identifies the actual parties as the Supreme Council of Antiquities on one side, and the Egyptian General Survey Authority and the Real Estate Publicity and Notarization Authority on the other. FAIL if the note does not identify all three bodies in their correct opposing positions as the actual parties to the dispute.

criteria.title: Binding opinion of the General Assembly
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note indicates that the General Assembly of the Fatwa and Legislation Sections (الجمعية العمومية لقسمي الفتوى والتشريع) is competent to resolve disputes between public bodies and its opinion is binding on both parties. FAIL if the note does not indicate that the General Assembly of the Fatwa and Legislation Sections is competent to resolve such disputes or does not state that its opinion is binding on both parties.
